Full code and outputs are embedded; these are exhaustive finite certificates, not extrapolations.

value.rationale: The exact least Paley 4-e.c. order is a motivated finite-model-theoretic threshold in a canonical deterministic random-like graph family. The complete prime-power exclusion below 89 and the precise rank-five Rado-theory connection refine classical eventual Paley n-e.c. theorems and an explicitly nonoptimal p>=193 sufficient bound. This is a natural structural/minimal classification, not a cherry-picked subfamily or textbook renaming.
